name: Salt
description: Iodised free-flowing table salt, called uppu in Kannada, used for everyday cooking, pickling and seasoning. A 1 kg pack is the standard household size and lasts a family several weeks.
mrp_source: https://blinkit.com/prn/tata-salt-vacuum-evaporated-iodised-salt/prid/105 (MRP Rs 32 for 1 kg, Sept 2026)

name: Sugar
description: White crystal sugar, called sakkare in Kannada, used for tea, coffee, payasa and festival sweets. A 1 kg pack suits a small family for two to three weeks of daily tea and cooking.
mrp_source: https://www.zepto.com/pn/madhur-pure-hygienic-sugar/pvid/3fd95375-ca7f-4527-92fa-66758967c1b3 (MRP Rs 65 for 1 kg, Sept 2026; loose sugar sells nearer Rs 45-50/kg)

name: Jaggery
description: Unrefined cane sugar in solid blocks, called bella in Kannada, used to sweeten holige, payasa, kadubu and everyday coffee in many Karnataka homes. A 1 kg block or bag covers a family's festival cooking and a few weeks of daily use.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026 (Bangalore mandi rate Rs 50-54/kg per commodityonline.com; packed 1 kg rounds Rs 99 on bigbasket.com; loose Mandya-style bella retails at Rs 70-90/kg)

image.credit: Sushant Medhe Pawar of Kolhapur Agricultural Produce Market

notes: Sold loose/by block in Hospet; no brand suggested.

name: Turmeric Powder
description: Ground dried turmeric root, called arishina in Kannada, added by the pinch to almost every sambar, palya, rasam and rice dish for colour and flavour. A 100 g pack lasts a family a month or two of daily cooking.
mrp_source: https://www.dmart.in/product/everest-turmeric-powder (Everest Turmeric Powder 100 g, MRP Rs 48, Sept 2026)
notes: Image shows an Aashirvaad 100 g pouch (cleanest licensed pack shot found); Everest 100 g on OFF was only a jar photo with a date stamp.

name: Chilli Powder
description: Ground dried red chillies, called menasina pudi in Kannada, the main source of heat in sambar, gojju, chutney pudi and non-veg gravies. A 200 g pack suits a family that cooks spicy food daily and lasts about a month.
mrp_source: https://blinkit.com/prn/everest-tikhalal-red-chilli-powder/prid/25281 (Everest Tikhalal 200 g, MRP Rs 128, Sept 2026; bigbasket lists Rs 102)
notes: Byadgi chilli powder is the local Hospet favourite; loose menasina pudi is also sold by weight at Rs 300-400/kg.

name: Coriander Powder
description: Ground dried coriander seed, called kothambari pudi in Kannada, used as the body of sambar, saaru and vegetable gravies and often mixed with chilli powder at the stove. A 100 g pack covers a small family's cooking for three to four weeks.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/100004178/everest-powder-green-coriander-100-g-pouch/ (Everest Green Coriander Powder 100 g listed at Rs 40, Sept 2026; older listings show MRP Rs 28-32)
notes: Image is the Everest coriander pouch photographed at the 200 g size; the 100 g pouch has the same artwork.

name: Cumin Seeds
description: Whole cumin seed, called jeerige in Kannada, used in tempering for rasam, upma, pulao and jeera rice, and roasted and ground into fresh masala. A 100 g pack keeps a family's spice box stocked for a month or more.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/40334088/tata-sampann-whole-spices-cumin-seeds-100-g/ (Tata Sampann Cumin Seeds 100 g, MRP Rs 70, Sept 2026)
notes: Often sold loose by weight in Hospet kiranas; generic bowl photo used rather than a brand pack.

name: Mustard Seeds
description: Small black-brown mustard seeds, called sasive in Kannada, popped in hot oil as the first step of almost every oggarane (tempering) for sambar, palya, chutney and pickles. A 100 g pack keeps a family's spice box going for a month or more since only a spoonful is used at a time.
mrp_source: https://blinkit.com/prn/catch-black-big-mustard-seeds/prid/388680 (Catch Black Big Mustard Seeds 100 g, MRP Rs 30-32, Sept 2026; Tata Sampann sells 200 g at Rs 57)
notes: Usually sold loose by weight in Hospet kiranas (Rs 120-160/kg); generic plate-of-seeds photo used rather than a brand pack.

name: Sambar Powder
description: Ready-ground sambar masala of roasted coriander, red chilli, dal and spices, called sambar pudi in Kannada, stirred into cooked toor dal and vegetables for everyday sambar and huli. A 100 g pouch makes sambar for a family of four roughly twenty times, so it lasts about a month of daily cooking.
mrp_source: https://shop.mtrfoods.com/products/mtr-sambar-powder-100-g-1 (MTR Sambar Powder 100 g, MRP Rs 76 for Karnataka, Sept 2026; bigbasket Rs 72, zepto MRP Rs 91)
notes: Image is the MTR Spicy Sambar Powder 100 g pouch (cleanest front shot on OFF); the regular MTR Sambar Powder 100 g entry (8901042954721) only has a back-of-pack photo, which itself shows Karnataka MRP Rs 76.

name: Rasam Powder
description: Ground spice mix of coriander, pepper, cumin, chilli and dal for making saaru (rasam), the thin tamarind-and-tomato soup eaten with rice in most Karnataka homes. A 100 g pouch makes saaru for a family of four around fifteen to twenty times, so it lasts a month of regular use.
mrp_source: https://shop.mtrfoods.com/products/mtr-rasam-powder-100-g (MTR Rasam Powder 100 g, MRP Rs 85, Sept 2026; bigbasket Rs 78)
notes: Image is the Adukale (Karnataka brand) Rasam Powder 200 g pouch: the only MTR rasam entry on OFF (8901042954738) has a back-of-pack photo only.

name: Tamarind
description: Dried, deseeded tamarind pulp, called hunase hannu in Kannada, soaked in water and squeezed to give sambar, saaru, gojju, puliyogare and chutneys their sour base. A 500 g pack lasts a family that cooks sambar or saaru most days about a month.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026 (bigbasket bb Popular deseeded tamarind 500 g Rs 123; Saaral seedless 500 g Rs 170; loose tamarind in Karnataka kiranas Rs 180-250/kg, so a 500 g slab runs Rs 90-125)
notes: Sold loose by weight or as unbranded 500 g slabs in Hospet; photo shows tamarind pods and wrapped pulp blocks at a market. OFF had only tamarind chutneys/sauces for India.

name: Milk
description: Pasteurised toned milk in the blue half-litre pouch, called haalu in Kannada, boiled at home for morning coffee, tea and evening milk, and set overnight for curd. A 500 ml pouch is the usual daily buy for a two-person household or one day's coffee and tea for a small family.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026 (KMF fixed Nandini toned milk at Rs 48/litre from 1 April 2025 per goodreturns.in and thehansindia.com, so the 500 ml pouch is Rs 24; no further revision reported)
notes: Nandini Pasteurised Toned Milk 500 ml pouch (KMF). Milk is sold at the KMF-fixed price statewide.

name: Curd
description: Fresh set curd, called mosaru in Kannada, eaten with rice at the end of most meals and used for raita, majjige (buttermilk) and curd rice. A 400 g pouch covers a small family's curd for a day or two and keeps for a couple of days in the fridge.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/40359295/nandini-curd-415-g-pouch/ (Nandini Curd 415 g pouch listed Rs 27, Sept 2026; the 500 g pouch retails Rs 32 on udupifresh.com)
notes: Image is the Nandini curd pouch photographed at the 500 g size; the 400 g pouch has the same artwork. KMF exempted curd from the Sept 2025 GST price cuts.

name: Butter
description: Pasteurised salted table butter, called benne in Kannada, spread on bread and dosa, melted over set dosa and pav, and used in baking. A 100 g bar suits a family that uses butter occasionally and is easy to finish before it goes off.
mrp_source: https://www.newkerala.com/news/a/bengaluru-milk-union-revises-nandini-ghee-butter-prices-665.htm (KMF revision: Nandini salted butter 100 g Rs 70, 500 g Rs 310, late 2025; no change reported since)
notes: Nandini Pasteurised Table Butter Salted 100 g carton. Photo is landscape (box lying flat).

name: Paneer
description: Fresh cottage cheese block made from cow milk, cubed for paneer butter masala, palak paneer, paneer tikka and fried rice. A 200 g pack makes one family-size curry and should be used within a day or two of opening.
mrp_source: https://world.openfoodfacts.org/product/8906036674524 (Nandini Paneer 200 g back panel photographed June 2026 shows MRP Rs 96.00, Rs 0.48/g; KMF 1 kg paneer Rs 408 after the Sept 2025 GST cut)
notes: Nandini Paneer 200 g pouch, current blue artwork.

name: Bread
description: Sliced white sandwich bread, eaten toasted with butter or jam at breakfast, made into bread omelette, sandwiches and bread upma, and softened in milk for kids. A 400 g loaf gives about 12-14 slices, enough for a small family's breakfasts for two or three days.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026 (Britannia Vitarich white sandwich bread 400 g MRP Rs 55 on starquik.com Mumbai; Modern/Britannia white 400 g sells at Rs 40-50 in Karnataka; local bakery loaves Rs 30-35)
notes: Image is a Britannia Sandwich Bread loaf (cleanest India white-bread pack shot on OFF); Modern's only OFF white-bread entry is the 600 g Sandwich Supreme. Hospet also has local bakery bread at lower prices.

name: Eggs
description: Farm chicken eggs, called motte in Kannada, boiled for breakfast, made into omelette, egg curry and egg rice, and used in cakes. A pack of six is a two- or three-day supply for a small family and is the usual quantity picked up along with bread and milk.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026 (NECC Bengaluru rate Rs 5.50/egg on 6 Sept 2026 per todayeggratesindia.com; retail Rs 6-7/egg, so a half-dozen is Rs 36-42; packed 6-egg cartons sell at Rs 45-55)
notes: Eggs are sold loose per piece at NECC-linked rates in Hospet; the photo shows a generic six-egg carton with white and brown eggs (Indian white-shell eggs are the norm). Price moves daily with the NECC rate.

name: Tea Powder
description: Strong CTC tea dust for boiling with milk and sugar into everyday chai, called chaha pudi in Kannada, the first thing made in most homes each morning and again at four o'clock. A 250 g pack gives around 100-120 cups, roughly a month for a household of two or three tea drinkers.
mrp_source: https://blinkit.com/prn/brooke-bond-red-label-tea-250-g/prid/185770 (Brooke Bond Red Label 250 g at Rs 125, Sept 2026; bigbasket carton Rs 120; pricehistory.app shows MRP Rs 125 on 6 Sept 2026 after a Rs 204 peak in March)
notes: Image is the Red Label 250 g carton held in hand (OFF entry has no quantity field but the carton format is the 250 g pack). 3 Roses and Taj Mahal are the other common picks in Karnataka.

name: Tea Powder
description: Premium CTC leaf-and-dust tea for milky chai, chaha pudi in Kannada, bought in the larger pack by families where tea is made three or four times a day or for offices and shops. A 500 g pack gives well over 200 cups and lasts a large household a month or more.
mrp_source: https://www.grosta.in/product/61/details/tata-tea-gold-leaf-500g (Tata Tea Gold 500 g MRP Rs 315, Sept 2026; another listing shows MRP Rs 360; Red Label 500 g sells at Rs 233 on blinkit)
notes: Image is the Tata Tea Gold 500 g pouch. Red Label 500 g is the cheaper mass option at about Rs 250.

name: Coffee Powder
description: Roasted and ground coffee-chicory blend for the brass filter, called kaafi pudi in Kannada, brewed into strong decoction and mixed with hot milk and sugar for the morning tumbler of filter coffee. A 200 g pack makes decoction for about a month in a two-coffee-a-day household.
mrp_source: https://www.mkretail.com/product/bru-green-label-coffee (Bru Green Label filter coffee 200 g MRP Rs 180, Sept 2026)
notes: Image is the Bru Green Label 100 g pouch; the 200 g pouch has the same artwork. Hospet also has local roasters selling fresh-ground chicory-blend coffee loose by weight (Rs 60-90 per 100 g).

name: Instant Coffee
description: Soluble coffee granules that dissolve straight into hot milk or water, the quick alternative to filter decoction for a morning or evening cup. A 50 g jar or pouch makes around 25-35 cups, a couple of weeks for a one-coffee-a-day household or a month for occasional use.
mrp_source: https://www.zepto.com/pn/bru-instant-coffee/pvid/d0e468d2-313c-4673-8c49-862a60f6d778 (Bru Instant 50 g pouch MRP Rs 140, Sept 2026; Nescafe Classic 50 g glass jar MRP Rs 230, bigbasket Rs 210)
notes: Image is a Nescafe Classic 45 g jar held in hand (the only clean instant-coffee pack shot on OFF; Bru Instant entries are Re 1 sachets or a cropped jar). Stock both: Bru Instant 50 g pouch at Rs 140 and Nescafe Classic 50 g jar at Rs 230.

name: Health Drink Powder
description: Malted milk-drink powder stirred into a glass of hot or cold milk, the usual morning and bedtime drink for school-going children and older family members. A 500 g jar gives about 25-30 glasses at two spoons each, roughly a month for one regular drinker.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/119386/horlicks-health-nutrition-drink-classic-malt-500-g-jar/ (Horlicks Classic Malt 500 g jar MRP Rs 259 after the Sept 2025 GST cut, listed Rs 264, Sept 2026; Boost 500 g jar MRP Rs 299)
notes: Image is a Cadbury Bournvita 500 g jar (the only upright, in-focus 500 g jar shot on OFF; the current Horlicks 500 g entry 8901030976100 is photographed lying on its side). Boost is the other big seller in Karnataka; Boost 500 g pouch/jar MRP Rs 239-299.
